# MaaJanki Web Tech

> MaaJanki Web Tech is the premier website development, AI solution, and digital marketing agency in Bihar, India, serving clients locally and globally (USA, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE). We specialize in high-performance web applications, enterprise admin portals, local SEO, performance marketing, and custom billing software.

## Services & Expertise
- **Web Development:** High-performance, SEO-optimized, and mobile-responsive websites built using Next.js 15, React 18, Tailwind CSS v4, and Node.js.
- **Enterprise Admin Dashboards:** Custom SaaS admin control panels with multi-page routing, MongoDB lead pipeline management, Recharts analytics, Leaflet geographic maps, and Clerk 2FA.
- **Search Engine Optimization (SEO):** Technical SEO audits, local SEO, Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization, keyword mapping, IndexNow indexing, and semantic link building.
- **Performance Marketing & Paid Ads:** Data-driven Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram), and PPC campaigns.
- **Social Media Optimization (SMO):** Brand promotion, account management, and audience engagement across Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.
- **Branding & Visual Identity:** Corporate logo design, brand strategy, visual guidelines, and graphic design.
- **UI/UX Design:** User-centric wireframing, interactive prototyping, and interface design.
- **Content Writing:** SEO-optimized website copy, blogs, and product descriptions.
- **E-Commerce Product Listing:** Cataloging and product listing optimization for Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, and Shopify.

## Key Products
- **InvoBill:** A hybrid, GST-compliant billing and invoicing software designed specifically for Indian retailers and small businesses.
